fields.statement: ArgentSea Core's published package declares exactly these external dependencies, each with an explicit version: Microsoft.CSharp, Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration, Microsoft.Extensions.Logging, Microsoft.Extensions.Options, Microsoft.Extensions.Options.ConfigurationExtensions, Polly, and System.Collections.Immutable. Polly is the package's only non-Microsoft dependency; it is the resilience library (retry and circuit-breaking) that ArgentSea Core's platform-neutral resilient command execution is implemented on top of.
fields.scope: ArgentSea Core NuGet package dependency declarations (ArgentSea.Shared/src/ArgentSea.csproj PackageReference items).
